verses.text: For the choirmaster. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.

xrefs.text: The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.
The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.
The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.
He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.

verses.text: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas,

xrefs.text: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”
Though an army encamps around me, my heart will not fear; though a war breaks out against me, I will keep my trust.
When you hear of wars and rebellions, do not be alarmed. These things must happen first, but the end is not imminent.

“Truly I tell you, Jesus replied, “if you have faith and do not doubt, not only will you do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you say to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea, it will happen.

verses.text: though their waters roar and foam and the mountains quake in the surge. Selah

xrefs.text: The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.

Do you not fear Me?” declares the LORD. “Do you not tremble before Me, the One who set the sand as the boundary for the sea, an enduring barrier it cannot cross? The waves surge, but they cannot prevail. They roar but cannot cross it.
He moves mountains without their knowledge and overturns them in His anger.
The mountains will melt beneath Him, and the valleys will split apart, like wax before the fire, like water rushing down a slope.
O LORD, when You went out from Seir, when You marched from the land of Edom, the earth trembled, the heavens poured out rain, and the clouds poured down water.

verses.text: There is a river whose streams delight the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.

xrefs.text: Then the angel showed me a river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb

Then the man brought me back to the entrance of the temple, and I saw water flowing from under the threshold of the temple toward the east (for the temple faced east). The water was coming down from under the south side of the temple, south of the altar.
They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.
As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of Hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish her forever. Selah
Glorious things are ascribed to you, O city of God. Selah

verses.text: God is within her; she will not be moved. God will help her when morning dawns.

xrefs.text: For I will be a wall of fire around it, declares the LORD, and I will be the glory within it.’”
The LORD has taken away your punishment; He has turned back your enemy. Israel’s King, the LORD, is among you; no longer will you fear any harm.
Then you will know that I am present in Israel and that I am the LORD your God, and there is no other. My people will never again be put to shame.
“Shout for joy and be glad, O Daughter of Zion, for I am coming to dwell among you,” declares the LORD.

and He said to me, “Son of man, this is the place of My throne and the place for the soles of My feet, where I will dwell among the Israelites forever. The house of Israel will never again defile My holy name— neither they nor their kings— by their prostitution and by the funeral offerings for their kings at their deaths.

verses.text: Nations rage, kingdoms crumble; the earth melts when He lifts His voice.

xrefs.text: The Lord GOD of Hosts, He who touches the earth and it melts, and all its dwellers mourn— all the land rises like the Nile, then sinks like the river of Egypt—
The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded— hailstones and coals of fire.
Plague went before Him, and fever followed in His steps.
The mountains quake before Him, and the hills melt away; the earth trembles at His presence— the world and all its dwellers.
The mountains will melt beneath Him, and the valleys will split apart, like wax before the fire, like water rushing down a slope.

verses.text: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah

xrefs.text: What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.

Only do not rebel against the LORD, and do not be afraid of the people of the land, for they will be like bread for us. Their protection has been removed, and the LORD is with us. Do not be afraid of them!”

Now behold, God Himself is with us as our head, and His priests with their trumpets sound the battle call against you. O children of Israel, do not fight against the LORD, the God of your fathers, for you will not succeed.”
and teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age.

verses.text: Come, see the works of the LORD, who brings devastation upon the earth.

xrefs.text: Come and see the works of God; how awesome are His deeds toward mankind.
Behold, the LORD lays waste the earth and leaves it in ruins. He will twist its surface and scatter its inhabitants—
They will rebuild the ancient ruins; they will restore the places long devastated; they will renew the ruined cities, the desolations of many generations.
For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds; I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.
The LORD is angry with all the nations and furious with all their armies. He will devote them to destruction; He will give them over to slaughter.

verses.text: He makes wars to cease throughout the earth; He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; He burns the shields in the fire.

xrefs.text: Then He will judge between the nations and arbitrate for many peoples. They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will no longer take up the sword against nation, nor train anymore for war.

Then He will judge between many peoples and arbitrate for strong nations far and wide. Then they will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will no longer take up the sword against nation, nor will they train anymore for war.
“In that day,” declares the LORD, “I will remove your horses from among you and wreck your chariots.
Joshua treated them as the LORD had told him; he hamstrung their horses and burned up their chariots.
No longer will violence be heard in your land, nor ruin or destruction within your borders. But you will name your walls Salvation and your gates Praise.

verses.text: “Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”

xrefs.text: Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.
But the LORD is in His holy temple; let all the earth be silent before Him.
I will magnify and sanctify Myself, and I will reveal Myself in the sight of many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
Be silent before the LORD, all people, for He has roused Himself from His holy dwelling.”
May they know that You alone, whose name is the LORD, are Most High over all the earth.

verses.text: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah

xrefs.text: The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He drives out the enemy before you, giving the command, ‘Destroy him!’

O LORD, my strength and my fortress, my refuge in the day of distress, the nations will come to You from the ends of the earth, and they will say, “Our fathers inherited nothing but lies, worthless idols of no benefit at all.
